diagnosis.root_cause: The bomb defect sits within an incomplete objective presentation: A/B hardware, the staged C rocket-bomb assembly, contextual narrative, interaction feedback, and terminal VFX must form one authoritative mission chain. The failure VFX still uses visibly primitive spherical geometry. Separately, weapon-report evidence lacks a mixed-output-ready owner and timing boundary, while the repeatedly treated environment defect requires source-versus-wrapper isolation because its protected numeric tuple already matches the registered baseline.

stop_conditions: Do not replace, slice, reimport, rebind, or edit the retained FireAudio/AutoFireAudio recordings, viewmodel hierarchy, profiles, transforms, recoil timings, or source addon.

Do not alter the protected environment tuple: background 0.8, ambient 0.85, sky contribution 0.75, FILMIC exposure and white point 1.0, SSAO 1.2/1.25/1.35, and sun energy 1.8. Do not compensate with fog, bloom, route lights, material tuning, post-processing, render scale, or enemy-count reduction.
Keep the authored environment as one intact source instance. Do not hide, extract, duplicate, reposition, or edit imported child meshes.
Do not ship PrimitiveMesh, CSG, untextured proxies, matte-contaminated cutouts, or floating/intersecting objective hardware as final visible art.

If mixed output remains unavailable, preserve the component and report the precise missing onset, tail, owner, or audible-identity evidence cell; telemetry and stream duration alone cannot authorize replacement.
If layer isolation finds no candidate-owned environment discrepancy, stop rendering changes and provide the isolation state for Tester review instead of repeating visual tuning.

Capture C from approach and interaction framing at 0/3, 1/3, 2/3, 3/3, interruption, defused, and detonated states; require a credible rocket/missile landmark, visible current component, readable progress, and unobstructed reticle and weapon.

Capture matched sunlit-spawn and shaded-route frames with the exact environment snapshot; require controlled highlights, legible PBR detail, readable shade and silhouettes, stable clouds/flare, and no clipped white ground or crushed structures.

The C device and HUD expose authoritative 0/3, 1/3, 2/3, and 3/3 progress. Only the legal stage is interactive; completed stages latch visibly, interruptions retain completed work, and presentation code cannot fabricate progress.

World devices, countdown, A/B/C identity, key count, checkpoint, objective band, prompt, story/radio, audio, and terminal presentation observe the same immutable mission events within two rendered frames, with no stale duplicate notices.

One terminal event spawns one world-scaled failure effect. Flash and light, irregular fire, sparks, debris, pressure wave, dust, camera shake/descent, red damage decay, and blast/tail audio are staged over the first 1.5 seconds without bubble spheres or flat primitive bars dominating.

Countdown zero commits detonation once, sets health to zero once, disables combat/input/collision, and reaches failure media or fallback plus retry/home. A 3/3 defusal commits success once and reaches the retained victory/result flow. Replay, Home, F6, and fresh deployment clear all objective, narrative, VFX, light, tween, overlay, and audio transients.
